subject: Initiating success plan: POC evaluation & benchmark ownership
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@avatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initiating success plan: POC evaluation & benchmark ownership

Hi Sara and team,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to get the POC moving. I want to kick off a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that focuses the evaluation so we can get to an acceptance decision in ~6 weeks. Attached is an initial MAP draft and a simple evaluation matrix that we can iterate on.

Proposed high-level success criteria (draft):
- Functional accuracy: 85%+ on the summarization & triage benchmark we discussed (measured by labeled sample set)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 200ms for 512-token completions under baseline load
- Economics: end-to-end inference cost <= $0.60 per 1,000 tokens in the Dedicated configuration (target)
- Data controls: no customer PII persisted in shared caches; audit logs enabled (we can add specifics once we confirm topology)

Suggested owners (proposed):
- Benchmarks & prompt templates: Marissa Cole
- Infra verification (VPC, network, KMS): Laura Bennett
- Quality/regression runs & pass criteria: Priyom Das
- SDK integration & sample app: Dylan Brooks

Timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff meeting + finalize MAP owners and baseline dataset
- Week 1: bench design & prompt templates produced
- Week 2: baseline runs & perf profiling
- Week 3–4: tuning and iteration (quantization/batching configs)
- Week 5: acceptance test run
- Week 6: final review & close decision

Next steps for now: please (1) confirm who from Ava will own acceptance/signoff, (2) flag any additional constraints (data residency, red-team, or compliance checks), and (3) volunteer any SMEs who should join the kickoff. I’ll circulate calendar invites once we have a core attendee list.

Attachments: RDW_Ava_MAP_v1.docx, evaluation_matrix.xlsx (stubs)

Thanks,
Connor Obrien
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@avatherapeutics.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ava Therapeutics - evaluation@avatherapeutics.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 18:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initiating success plan: POC evaluation & benchmark ownership

Connor —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses from our side:
- Acceptance/signoff owner: myself (Sara Gomez) and Alex Liu (Head of ML Ops) will be final approvers.
- Internal SMEs to include on kickoff: Priya Raman (data compliance), Diego Soto (platform eng), and Nina Park (clinical SME for label guidance). I’ll loop them into the calendar invite.
- One additional constraint: data residency — the POC must ensure all raw patient-test artifacts remain in our EU project bucket; any telemetry we receive should be hashed and encrypted before it leaves our environment.

Success criteria look reasonable overall. On economics: can we add an acceptance gate related to per-API-call tail latency under 99th perc as a soft guardrail?

Proposed times for kickoff next week: Tue 10am ET or Wed 2pm ET.

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Gomez
Head of Integrations, Ava Therapeutics
[sara.gomez@avatherapeutics.com]

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@avatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 00:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initiating success plan: POC evaluation & benchmark ownership

Sara — thanks, that’s helpful. We’ll incorporate the EU residency requirement into the MAP and add a 99th-percentile tail-latency soft gate. Updated plan below with explicit owners and milestone dates — I’ve also uploaded a revised MAP (RDW_Ava_MAP_v1 - revA) to the Drive link and added a HubSpot task for follow-up.

Updated owners and responsibilities:
- Bench & prompt templates (create labeled sample & test harness): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com)
- Infra compliance & network/KMS validation (verify EU bucket connectivity + keys): Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com)
- Quality/regression & acceptance criteria (stat tests, label agreement): Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.inference.com)
- SDK + sample app (integration + smoke tests): Dylan Brooks (dylan_brooks@redwood.inference.com)
- Redwood PM / escalation (calendar + status): Connor Obrien

Milestone calendar (hard dates):
- 2027-04-05: MAP kickoff (finalize dataset and owners)
- 2027-04-12: Benchmark design and prompt templates delivered
- 2027-04-19: Baseline performance & quality runs completed
- 2027-05-03: Tuning complete; acceptance test scheduled
- 2027-05-10: Final review & decision window

Action items for the team:
- Marissa: build initial prompt set and share a short scoring rubric by 2027-04-12
- Laura: validate EU bucket path and confirm KMS flow by 2027-04-12
- Priyom: draft the statistical acceptance test and thresholding approach
- Dylan: prepare SDK sample that demonstrates end-to-end call and token accounting

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRDW-Ava-MAP
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Attachments: RDW_Ava_MAP_v1-revA.docx (uploaded to Drive)

Connor

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference.com>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@avatherapeutics.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 02:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initiating success plan: POC evaluation & benchmark ownership

Copy — I’ll own the scoring harness and the statistical acceptance tests. Quick notes:
- I’ll start with a small labeled cohort (n=500) for initial QA and iterate to n=2,000 for final acceptance.
- For prompt ownership: Marissa, I’ll pair with you on rubric design so we can automate label agreement scoring.
- For latency gates: I’ll produce both 95th and 99th percentile reports and include synthetic-load runs to validate stability.

I’ll post the first draft of the scoring harness to the Drive by EOD Wed (2027-04-07).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Applied ML — Inference Evaluation, Redwood Inference
